items.exampleEn: A cat that loves playing in water is quite atypical.
This sofa is adaptable; it turns into a bed for guests.
items.exampleZh: 這張沙發能靈活變換，可以變成給客人睡的床。

items.exampleEn: The hotel's service was unsatisfactory, so we complained to the manager.
items.exampleZh: 那間飯店的服務令人不滿意，所以我們向經理反映。

items.exampleEn: The sky turned a steely gray before the storm.
items.exampleZh: 暴風雨來臨前，天空變成鋼鐵般的灰色。

items.exampleEn: He wore a gaudy shirt with huge pink flowers.
items.exampleZh: 他穿了一件印著大朵粉紅花的花俏襯衫。

items.exampleEn: The tall trees grew skyward in search of light.
items.exampleZh: 高大的樹木朝著天空生長，尋找陽光。

items.exampleEn: The farmer's tanned hands showed years of outdoor work.
items.exampleZh: 農夫曬黑的雙手顯示出多年的戶外工作。

items.exampleEn: The writer graphically describes life on a fishing boat.
items.exampleZh: 那位作家生動地描寫漁船上的生活。

items.sentenceEn: The rocket rose skyward and soon disappeared into the clouds.
items.sentenceZh: 火箭直衝天際，很快就消失在雲裡。

items.audioEn: Your first report was unsatisfactory, but this one is much clearer, so well done.
items.audioZh: 你的第一份報告不太令人滿意，但這一份清楚多了，做得好。

items.sentenceEn: The chart graphically shows how much water each family uses.
items.sentenceZh: 這張圖表清楚呈現每個家庭用多少水。

items.sentenceEn: The coach gave his players a steely look before the final.
items.sentenceZh: 決賽前，教練用冷峻的眼神看著球員。

items.stemEn: This plant is not very ____; it can only grow in warm, wet places.
items.stemZh: 這種植物適應力不強，只能長在溫暖潮濕的地方。

items.stemEn: The children pointed ____ when they saw the big balloon floating above the park.
items.stemZh: 孩子們看到公園上空飄著大氣球時，都往天上指。

items.passageEn: Last summer, my cousin worked at a small cafe by the beach. The owner wanted every worker to be adaptable, because one day you might make coffee and the next day you might clean windows. The weather that summer was atypical: it rained almost every afternoon, so business was slow. The pay was a little unsatisfactory, and the uniforms were gaudy orange outfits that everyone hated. Still, my cousin came home tanned and happy, with many funny stories.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我表哥在海邊一家小咖啡館打工。老闆希望每個員工都能靈活應變，因為你今天可能煮咖啡，明天可能要擦窗戶。那年夏天的天氣不太尋常：幾乎每天下午都下雨，所以生意很冷清。薪水有點不盡理想，制服又是大家都討厭的俗氣橘色套裝。不過，表哥還是曬得黝黑、開開心心地回家，帶回很多好笑的故事。

questions.questionZh: 那年夏天的天氣怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 打了一整個夏天的網球後，她的手臂曬黑了。
referenceEn: After a whole summer of tennis, her arms were tanned.
Her arms got tanned from playing tennis all summer.
rubricZh: 要用 tanned（例如 were tanned、got tanned 等）
時態合理即可（例如 were、got 等）

items.promptZh: 那棟房子被漆成俗氣的亮綠色。
referenceEn: That house was painted a gaudy bright green.
The house was painted in a gaudy shade of bright green.
rubricZh: gaudy 可放名詞前或 be／look 後（例如 a gaudy bright green、looks gaudy 等）
「被漆成」可寫，例如 was painted、is painted 等；主動句（例如 They painted…）也正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："It is atypical for him to be late; he is usually early."；改後："A cat that loves playing in water is quite atypical."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX 4：與 l05 uncharacteristic 句型、事件相同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："他遲到很不尋常，他通常都很早到。"；改後："愛玩水的貓相當少見。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX 5：
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："企鵝的適應力不太強，只能住在寒冷的地方。"；改後："這種植物適應力不強，只能長在溫暖潮濕的地方。"

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX 6：
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["He came back from the beach tanned and relaxed.", "He returned from the beach looking tanned and relaxed."]；改後：["After a whole summer of tennis, her arms were tanned.", "Her arms got tanned from playing tennis all summer."]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 FIX 6：
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["要用 tanned（例如 tanned and relaxed）", "可搭配動詞，例如 came back、returned、looked 等"]；改後：["要用 tanned（例如 were tanned、got tanned 等）", "時態合理即可（例如 were、got 等）"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：graphically 釋義改通順
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："用圖表地"；改後："生動地"
